backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining booking and message submission endpoints with in-memory storage using Maps, including validation and query methods for retrieving all bookings.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a requirement to update the email input field in the Booking component to use 'X' as the input symbol/icon.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components (Hero, Services, About, Booking with X icon email field, ContactForm, Footer, ServiceAreaMap), hooks (useContactForm, useBookingForm), and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes with warm orange/amber accents and deep blue-gray primary colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with page title 'Friends AC Services' and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component rendering the complete page layout with Hero, Services, About, Booking, ServiceAreaMap, ContactForm, Footer sections and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/About.tsx: About section component displaying four statistics cards (years experience, happy customers, certifications, 24/7 support) with icons and a commitment statement.
frontend/src/components/Booking.tsx: Booking form component with service type selection, date picker, time slot selection, and contact fields including an email input with X icon (lucide-react), submitting to backend via useBookingForm hook.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Contact form component with name, phone, email, service type selector, and message textarea fields, plus three contact info cards displaying phone numbers, email, and location.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying company info, contact details (phone, email, location), business hours, and social media links for Friends AC Services.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section component with background image, headline, description, and call-to-action buttons that scroll to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/ServiceAreaMap.t: Service area map component displaying coverage areas with an image map and list of serviced locations (downtown, suburban, industrial, residential).
frontend/src/components/Services.tsx: Services section component displaying four AC service offerings (Installation, Repair, Maintenance, Emergency Service) in a responsive card grid.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity, with automatic query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBookingForm.ts: Custom hook for submitting booking form data to the backend actor, with mutation handling, toast notifications, and query cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Custom hook for submitting contact form messages to the backend actor, with mutation handling, toast notifications, and query cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives and custom CSS variables defining light/dark theme colors (blue-gray primary, orange accent) for the AC services brand.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom theme extensions including color schemes using OKLCH color space, typography settings with Inter font, container queries, animations, and custom border radius and shadow utilities.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for an AC services website documenting implemented features including hero section, services listing, contact/booking forms, about section, footer, and branding updates with 'Friends AC Services' as the company name.
